chunks.text: The National Savings Institute page states the Sukanya Samriddhi Account Scheme allows a minimum deposit of 250 rupees and a maximum deposit of 1.5 lakh rupees in a financial year.
The account can be opened for a girl child until she turns 10 years old, is available in post offices and authorised banks, matures after 21 years, and qualifies for Section 80C tax benefits.
